name: percena
description: Percena marketplace: Lattice workflow skills and the Claude Code lattice plugin. Portable skills live under skills/; the plugin adds packaging and optional hooks.

plugins.name: lattice
plugins.description: Full Lattice loop for Claude: start-work, create-spec, create-review, create-tickets, batch-work, create-pr, finish-work, _lattice-lib, create-adr, run-e2e, verify-features, generate-wiki, and the review-code/review-production/review-delivery/review-lineage side-paths. Optional hooks block bare gh pr create/merge and gh issue create by default (strict) unless the owning skill is active; LATTICE_HOOK_MODE=advisory downgrades them to nudges.
